title: Regularized Score Centering
abstract: arXiv:2611.21791v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We

translated_abstract: 异步强化学习提高了训练吞吐量，但来自过时策略的数据以及训练与推理之间的数值不匹配可能会使学习过程变得不稳定。为了稳定离策略学习，分数中心化（SC）消除了奖励基线对预期更新的影响。我们的梯度诊断显示，与重要性采样（IS）相比，SC 产生的极端梯度更少，但当学习器偏离生成数据的行为策略太远时，SC 仍然可能失效。为了限制这种策略不匹配，我们引入了正则化分数中心化（RSC），它通过添加一个反向 Kullback-Leibler（KL）惩罚，鼓励学习器的下一词元分布保持接近行为策略的下一词元分布。RSC 既可以与截断重要性采样（TIS）结合使用，也可以单独使用，TIS 会对词元重要性权重设置上限。我们的理论分析支持这一方法，表明 KL 正则化改善了收敛保证。
tldr: 本文提出正则化分数中心化（RSC），通过引入反向 KL 惩罚使学习器的下一词元分布保持接近行为策略，从而限制策略不匹配、稳定异步离策略强化学习，并在理论上证明 KL 正则化改善了收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse KL penalty to keep the learner's next-token distribution close to the behavior policy's, limiting policy mismatch and stabilizing asynchronous off-policy RL, with theoretical analysis showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees.
